Which power station will run my appliances?

A station is two numbers, and only one of them is on the box in large type. Watts decide what you can switch on; watt-hours decide how long it stays on. The machines below are grouped by the second, because that is the number that does not change when you change your mind about the appliance.

Each card links to that machine’s own record, where every figure carries the tier and the date it was verified on. For some of these builds we have found no surge ceiling at all; those cards say so rather than showing a floor this site worked out for itself.

Size a machine for your loads →

Already know the machine and want to know how long it lasts? The runtime calculator puts any of these records against the same list of loads.
